# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the Typer application. Do not edit by hand:
     run `uv run python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Every command reads its configuration from the environment (see
[Trust model](../guide/trust-model.md) and [Install](../guide/install.md)), writes structured JSON
logs to standard error and its result to standard output. Exit code `0` is success, `1` the command
ran and failed (unreadable or invalid input, a gate that matched, a lossy `--strict` conversion),
`2` a usage or configuration error, `130` an interrupt.

## datacopilot

`datacopilot [--version] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`apply`](#datacopilot-apply) | Write the accepted proposals as a NEW dataset; the original is not changed. |
| [`audit`](#datacopilot-audit) | Audit a dataset.dcp, write reports and exit with the gate's verdict. |
| [`doctor`](#datacopilot-doctor) | Check the installation: versions, extras, settings, cache directory, FAISS and GPU. |
| [`embed`](#datacopilot-embed) | Compute and store the embeddings of every image so that `audit --embedder` can reuse them. |
| [`export`](#datacopilot-export) | Write a dataset.dcp in another format and print the output directory. |
| [`formats`](#datacopilot-formats) | List registered formats as name, capabilities, license and extra (tab separated). |
| [`ingest`](#datacopilot-ingest) | Convert a dataset into a versioned dataset.dcp directory and print its version. |
| [`propose`](#datacopilot-propose) | Find boxes a dataset is probably missing and store them as a proposal set. |
| [`review export`](#datacopilot-review-export) | Write the proposals as a separate layer of a CVAT dataset, next to the dataset's own boxes. |
| [`review import`](#datacopilot-review-import) | Read the decisions of a reviewed CVAT export into a new, reviewed proposal set. |
| [`split`](#datacopilot-split) | Re-split a dataset by group and write it as a NEW dataset; the original is not changed. |

`--version` prints the version and exits.

## datacopilot apply

Write the accepted proposals as a NEW dataset; the original is not changed.

Only accepted proposals of a REVIEWED set (from `review import`) are applied (pending and rejected
ones never are); the reviewed set and the one it came from are copied into the new dataset. The new
dataset records the old version in its lineage, and each new box has provenance `proposal_accepted`
with the proposal and set ids. Refused, writing nothing: a set made for another dataset version or
by a model that is not the pinned one or not allowed (DATACOPILOT_ALLOWED_LICENSES), a tampered set,
an incomplete run (without --allow-incomplete), a set with nothing accepted, an output that exists
or lies inside the dataset. Prints the new version. Exit codes: 0 success; 1 refused or unreadable;
2 bad option.

```text
datacopilot apply [OPTIONS] DATASET
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATASET` | A dataset.dcp directory. |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposals` (required) | `TEXT` |  | Reviewed proposal set id (from `review import`). |
| `--output` / `-o` (required) | `PATH` |  | New dataset directory (*.dcp). |
| `--allow-incomplete` |  | off | Also apply a set from a run that did not reach every image. |
| `--allow-test-proposer` |  | off | Also apply a set made by a test double such as test_boxes (its boxes say nothing about the pictures). |

## datacopilot audit

Audit a dataset.dcp, write reports and exit with the gate's verdict.

Prints one line (`passed|failed critical=N warn=N info=N run_id=ID`) and stores the run as
audits/<run_id>.json. The default gate is `--fail-on critical`; `--fail-on none` applies no gate.
Exit codes: 0 gate passed (or no gate); 1 a --fail-on match, an empty dataset or an unreadable
dataset, an image the leakage check could not embed (under a gate), an embedder that is not allowed
(DATACOPILOT_ALLOWED_LICENSES) or fails to load; 2 bad option or configuration (unknown check, bad
--fail-on, bad value).

```text
datacopilot audit [OPTIONS] DATASET
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATASET` | A dataset.dcp directory. |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--checks` | `TEXT` | `all` | `all` or a comma-separated list of check names. |
| `--fail-on` | `TEXT` |  | Comma-separated gate: critical, warn, info (that severity and above) and/or check names; exit 1 if any finding matches. Default: critical. `none` applies no gate. |
| `--report` | `PATH` |  | HTML report path (default ./report.html); JSON and SARIF go next to it. |
| `--json` | `PATH` |  | JSON report path. |
| `--sarif` | `PATH` |  | SARIF 2.1.0 report path. |
| `--workers` | `INT (1..256)` |  | Threads for file checks (default: CPUs). |
| `--hash-cache` / `--no-hash-cache` |  |  | Use the file-hash cache (default: on). CI gates should pass --no-hash-cache. |
| `--require-local-images` |  | off | Treat any image the audit could not examine (remote, external) as CRITICAL. |
| `--allow-external-images` |  | off | Also read images whose real path is outside the dataset's parent directory. |
| `--no-store-audit` |  | off | Do not write audits/<run_id>.json into the dataset (read-only checkouts). |
| `--allow-external-images-in-ci` |  | off | Confirm --allow-external-images when the CI environment variable is set. |
| `--embedder` | `TEXT` |  | Embedder name (for example dinov2_base, siglip2_base; needs the [embed] extra): adds the near_duplicates, leakage, label_noise and outliers checks to `--checks all`. |
| `--embed-batch` | `INT (1..1024)` |  | Images per embedder call. |
| `--similarity-threshold` | `FLOAT` |  | Cosine similarity (above 0, at most 1) from which images are near-duplicates and cross-split pairs are leakage (default 0.95). |
| `--embedding-cache` / `--no-embedding-cache` |  | on | Keep embeddings in dataset.dcp/embeddings (authenticated; default: on). |
| `--allow-test-embedder` |  | off | Allow a test-only embedder such as `hash` (it compares file bytes, not pictures) to drive a gate. Without it such an embedder is refused unless `--fail-on none`. |
| `--require-cache-key` |  | off | Fail (exit 2) unless DATACOPILOT_CACHE_KEY is set, whether or not CI is detected (only the CI variable is looked at). Use it where the cache directory is shared or restored from elsewhere. |
| `--include-model-annotations` |  | off | Also audit annotations whose provenance is `model` (for example Label Studio predictions). By default they are left out of every check, because model output is not ground truth, and the number left out is reported. |
| `--show-group-labels` |  | off | Show group ids in leakage findings (default: only a hashed reference; group ids come from file paths and can carry names). |

## datacopilot doctor

Check the installation: versions, extras, settings, cache directory, FAISS and GPU.

Prints the status (`ok`, `warn` or `fail`) and one line per section, or with --json one JSON object
(schema 1). Never prints secrets. Exit codes: 0 ok or warn; 1 a core dependency is missing; 2 an
invalid DATACOPILOT_* setting (reported in the output).

```text
datacopilot doctor [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | off | Print the report as one JSON object. |

## datacopilot embed

Compute and store the embeddings of every image so that `audit --embedder` can reuse them.

Resumable: shards already stored (and verified) are kept. Prints one line (`embedded=N total=T
cached=C missing=M model=ID@REV run_id=ID`). Exit codes: 0 every image has an embedding and the
cache was written; 1 any image could not be embedded, the embedder failed, the budget ended the run,
the cache could not be written, an embedder that is not allowed or an unreadable dataset; 2 bad
option, or a cache that cannot be used (for example `CI` set without `DATACOPILOT_CACHE_KEY`, or
`--no-embedding-cache`): nothing would be stored.

```text
datacopilot embed [OPTIONS] DATASET
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATASET` | A dataset.dcp directory. |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--embedder` (required) | `TEXT` |  | Embedder name (needs the [embed] extra). |
| `--embed-batch` | `INT (1..1024)` |  | Images per embedder call. |
| `--embedding-cache` / `--no-embedding-cache` |  | on | Store the embeddings in dataset.dcp/embeddings (default: on). |
| `--require-cache-key` |  | off | Fail (exit 2) unless DATACOPILOT_CACHE_KEY is set. |

## datacopilot export

Write a dataset.dcp in another format and print the output directory.

Every image is verified before it is copied: it must lie inside the directory that holds the dataset
(unless --allow-external-images), not be a symlink to elsewhere and match its image_id; otherwise
nothing is exported.

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 unreadable dataset, unknown format, non-empty output, or --strict with
dropped fields (nothing is written); 2 bad option or configuration.

```text
datacopilot export [OPTIONS] DATASET
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATASET` | A dataset.dcp directory. |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` / `-f` (required) | `TEXT` |  | Format name; see `datacopilot formats`. |
| `--output` / `-o` (required) | `PATH` |  | Empty or new output directory. |
| `--strict` |  | off | Fail if any field cannot be carried to the format. |
| `--allow-external-images` |  | off | Also copy images whose real path is outside the dataset's parent directory (each must still match its image_id). Do not use on datasets you do not trust. |

## datacopilot formats

List registered formats as name, capabilities, license and extra (tab separated).

```text
datacopilot formats [OPTIONS]
```

## datacopilot ingest

Convert a dataset into a versioned dataset.dcp directory and print its version.

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 unreadable or invalid input, unknown format, output exists, or --strict
with skipped or dropped input (nothing is written); 2 bad option or configuration.

```text
datacopilot ingest [OPTIONS] PATH
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | Dataset root (or annotation file) to read. |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` / `-f` (required) | `TEXT` |  | Format name; see `datacopilot formats`. |
| `--output` / `-o` (required) | `PATH` |  | New dataset directory (*.dcp). |
| `--group-by` | `TEXT` |  | Regex over the image path; group `g` (or 1) is the group id. |
| `--name` | `TEXT` |  | Dataset name (default: input name). |
| `--strict` |  | off | Fail (nothing is written) if the reader skipped or dropped anything. |
| `--keep-task-data` |  | off | label_studio only: also keep the task data fields other than `image` (they are dropped and counted by default because they can hold personal data or URLs). |

## datacopilot propose

Find boxes a dataset is probably missing and store them as a proposal set.

Nothing is applied and the dataset is not changed. The model is asked about every class (or
--classes) in every image. A box is proposed only if the image has no box of that class at the same
place already (IoU 0.5). Prints one line (`proposed=N images=DONE/TOTAL set=ID model=ID@REV
run_id=ID`); the set id is what `review` and `apply` take. Exit codes: 0 the run reached every
image; 1 the run is incomplete (the time budget ended it, an image could not be read; the partial
set is stored and `apply` refuses it without --allow-incomplete), a model that is not allowed
(DATACOPILOT_ALLOWED_LICENSES) or fails, a missing extra, or an unreadable or non-detection dataset;
2 bad option.

```text
datacopilot propose [OPTIONS] DATASET
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATASET` | A dataset.dcp directory. |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposer` | `TEXT` | `grounding_dino` | Proposer name; grounding_dino needs the [vlm] extra (and downloads its model once), test_boxes is a test double. |
| `--classes` | `TEXT` |  | Comma-separated class names to look for (default: all). |
| `--min-score` | `FLOAT` | `0.35` | Lowest confidence kept (above 0, at most 1). |
| `--min-score-for` | `TEXT` |  | CLASS=SCORE: a lowest confidence for one class; repeat for more classes. |
| `--time-budget` | `FLOAT` | `3600.0` | Seconds after which the run stops with an incomplete set. |

## datacopilot review export

Write the proposals as a separate layer of a CVAT dataset, next to the dataset's own boxes.

Open the output in CVAT (import it as "CVAT for images 1.1"). The proposals are boxes whose label is
the class name plus `__proposed`; each has a `decision` attribute: type `accepted` or `rejected`
(empty means undecided) and move the box first to correct it. Deleting a box decides nothing. Prints
the output directory. Exit codes: 0 success; 1 unreadable dataset, an unknown, tampered or
mismatching set, a non-empty output; 2 bad option.

```text
datacopilot review export [OPTIONS] DATASET
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATASET` | A dataset.dcp directory. |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposals` (required) | `TEXT` |  | Proposal set id (from `propose`). |
| `--to` (required) | `TEXT` |  | Annotation tool; only `cvat` is built. |
| `--output` / `-o` (required) | `PATH` |  | Empty or new output directory. |

## datacopilot review import

Read the decisions of a reviewed CVAT export into a new, reviewed proposal set.

The original set is not changed: a new set names it as its parent, and its id is printed. Only the
proposal layer is read; edits to the dataset's own boxes are ignored and counted. A decision file
that names an unknown, repeated or foreign proposal, changes a class, uses an invalid decision or
moves an accepted box outside its image is refused as a whole. Prints `accepted=N rejected=N
pending=N edited=N edited_pending=N ignored=N skipped=N set=ID`. Exit codes: 0 success; 1 unreadable
dataset or file, a refused decision file or no decision in it; 2 bad option.

```text
datacopilot review import [OPTIONS] DATASET DIRECTORY
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATASET` | A dataset.dcp directory. |
| `DIRECTORY` | The reviewed CVAT export (a directory). |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposals` (required) | `TEXT` |  | Proposal set id that was exported. |
| `--from` (required) | `TEXT` |  | Annotation tool; only `cvat` is built. |

## datacopilot split

Re-split a dataset by group and write it as a NEW dataset; the original is not changed.

Groups are images with the same --by-group key and, with --near-dup, near copies (every pair at or
above the threshold). Whole groups are assigned, largest first, to the split that keeps the image
counts (and with --stratify category the class counts) closest to --ratios; the same input, ratios
and seed give the same assignment whatever the row order. The new dataset records the old version in
its lineage. Prints the new version, a summary line and one line per split (`<split> images=N
target=T deviation=D`). Exit codes: 0 written; 1 refused (an image that could not be embedded, too
many near-copy pairs, a split identical to the current one, an output that exists or lies inside the
dataset) or unreadable; 2 bad option.

```text
datacopilot split [OPTIONS] DATASET
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `DATASET` | A dataset.dcp directory. |

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` / `-o` (required) | `PATH` |  | New dataset directory (*.dcp). |
| `--ratios` | `TEXT` | `0.8,0.1,0.1` | Train, val and test fractions that sum to 1. |
| `--by-group` | `TEXT` | `group_id` | Images with the same key stay together: `group_id` (default), `source.<name>` or `re:<pattern>` over the file name (a bounded, safe pattern; the named group `g` or group 1 is the key). The new version's group_id is the key. |
| `--near-dup` |  | off | Also keep near copies together: every image pair whose embeddings reach --similarity-threshold (needs --embedder; every image must be embedded). |
| `--embedder` | `TEXT` |  | Embedder for --near-dup. |
| `--similarity-threshold` | `FLOAT` |  | Cosine similarity of near copies (default 0.95). |
| `--embed-batch` | `INT (1..1024)` |  | Images per embedder call. |
| `--stratify` | `TEXT` |  | `category`: also balance each class across splits. |
| `--seed` | `INT` | `0` | Breaks ties between groups of equal size (0 to 2^32-1). |
| `--json` | `PATH` |  | Write the split report as JSON to this new file (outside the dataset; an existing file or a symlink is refused). |
| `--allow-test-embedder` |  | off | Allow a test-only embedder such as `hash` (it compares file bytes, not pictures) for --near-dup; refused without it. |
